Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public. 




Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan 
"The Right to Information, The Right to Live"

Indian Standard (Reaffirmed 1998) 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
PLIERS, BRACKET OPENING, DENTAL

1. Scope — Dimensional end other requirements for bracket opening pliers used in dentistry. 

2. Shape and Dimensions — As shown in Fig. 1 and 2. 

2.1 The tolerances on various dimensions shall be permitted as follows: 

± 0'1 mm for dimensions up to 5 mm; 

± 0*2 mm for dimensions above 5 mm and up to 10 mm; and 

± 10 mm for dimensions above 10 mm. 

2.2 Joint — Box type conforming to 6 of IS ; 3642-1078 'General requirements for surgical 
instruments ( first revision ) \ 

3. Material — Pliers shall be made of tool steel conforming to Designation T80 of IS : 3749-1978 
* Specification for tool and die steels for cold work {first revision)*. Pliers may also be made of 
stainless steel of Grade 30Cr13 of IS ; 6603-1972 ' Specification for stainless steel bars and fiats '. 

4. Workmanship and Finish 

4.1 The two halves of the pliers shall move freely at the joint without any play. The movement shall 
be even and the jaws shall register accurately. 

4.2 The pliers shall be free from rough edges, pits, burrs cracks and other surface defects. The 
edges shall be rounded except those of working end. 

4.3 The surfaces of the pliers shall be finished bright except the outside surfaces of the handles 
which shall have m*tt finish. 

4.4 The ends of the screw joint shall be finished flush with the surfaces. 

4.5 The pliers made from tool steel (see 3) shall be plated chromium over nickel and the plating 
shall conform to Service Grade 2 of IS : 1068-1968 ' Specification for electroplated coatings of 
nickel and chromium on iron and steel (first revision) \ 

5. Heat Treatment — The pliers shall be hardened and tempered to a hardness of 500 HV 
minimum [ see IS : 1501-1968 Method for vrckers hardness test for steel (first revision ) ]. 

6. Test 

6.1 Corrosion Resistance — The pliers shall be tested in accordance with IS : 7531-1975 ' Method 
for boiling and autoclaving test for corrosion resistance of stainless steel surgical instruments '. It 
shall show no sign of corrosion after the test, 

7. Marking — The pliers shall be legibly and indelibly marked with the manufacturer's name, initials 
or registered trade-mark. 

7.1 iSI Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 

8. Packing — The pliers shall be put either in polyethylene bag or wrapped in wax paper and shall 
then be packed in carton in accordance with the current trade practice. The carton shall bear the 
name of the pliers, manufacturer's name, initials or registered trade-mark. 

8.1 The pliers may also be packed as agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier. 



Adopted 27 February 1981
